name: Demonic Possession
overview: Scripture reveals that demonic possession involves individuals being controlled or oppressed by unclean spirits, as seen in accounts where Jesus heals those afflicted, restoring sight and speech (Matthew 12:22) and commanding demons to depart with immediate effect (Matthew 17:18). The Gospels describe such encounters in various settings, including synagogues and foreign regions (Luke 4:33, Mark 5:1), highlighting the reality of spiritual bondage. The early church also faced manifestations of demonic influence, such as the spirit of divination in Acts 16:16. Believers are called to stand firm in the Lord's power, relying on His might to overcome these spiritual adversaries (Ephesians 6:10).
